items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: A Shade of Difference. Gary Bartz, Dick Katz, Jim Hall, Richard Davis, Elvin Jones. ... I didn’t know I played with him.

ctx.x: I kind of remember that too.
A Shade of Difference. Gary Bartz, Dick Katz, Jim Hall, Richard Davis, Elvin Jones.
I didn’t know I played with him. I don’t remember playing the record with him.
